criteria.G0: Exact baseline, `HEAD`/dirty input inventory, toolchain, feature flags, executable hashes, host/process identity, criteria/fixture lock before runs; immutable earlier evidence; independent acceptance witness.
criteria.G1: ADR decision compares alternatives; precise supported/unsupported matrix maps all eight PRD Phase23 features, INV1–10 and Phase12 constraints; no hidden widening.
criteria.G2: Two real principals/tokens, authenticated UDS, per-tenant visibility/cancel/result policy, revocation; cross-tenant key and ID oracle; symlink/path/race/forgery refusals; no secrets in logs.
criteria.G3: New, duplicate, changed-key, concurrent duplicate, crash-between-fsync and acknowledgment, overflow/exhaustion; original deadline, enqueue order, immutable request persist across restart.
criteria.G4: Pure policy model/property checks plus real multi-tenant backlogged native runs; predeclared equal/weighted share and finite-aging witness; no starvation or undocumented priority inversion.
criteria.G5: At every boundary: tenant/global queued/active/slot/managed-byte/staging/output/cost constraints; reject vs wait distinction; checked arithmetic; no worker effects on refused admission; refunds exactly once.
criteria.G6: Two separate externally supervised 2–4 worker cohorts actually overlap; cohort-store/boot pins and all `runner.lock`/drain invariants; negative same-cohort double-claim and worker reuse tests.
criteria.G7: Running low-priority preemptible native aggregate/join canceled/drained then restarted as fresh native job with stable logical ID; high priority progresses; nonpreemptible refusal; native committed-vs-cancel race; poison/unreachable cohort quarantine.
criteria.G8: SIGKILL at every persisted-effect boundary, manager restart, native coordinator death, worker death, slow/unresponsive control peer, metadata ENOSPC, bad/checksummed snapshots, clock rollback, duplicate notifications; no replay before drain.
criteria.G9: Independently recompute per-job and per-attempt measured/unknown cost, retries/preemptions, reservation lifetimes, billable/idle pool usage, pinned price model; no double billing, fabricated zero or budget underflow.
criteria.G10: Real 1->2->1 active-cohort change under queue pressure/idle, observed simultaneous native execution and safe downshift; standby remains provisioned explicitly, no physical-autoscale claim.
criteria.G11: Two tenants, at least one nontrivial aggregate and join, expected outputs from **independently authored literal fixture/oracle**, empty/boundary outputs, no foreign/partial reads; exact schema/multiplicity/committed hash and worker closure.
criteria.G12: Oversized/slow/forged request, auth brute/resource exhaustion bounds, unauthorized source, symlink swaps, state corruption, disk-full/permission errors, cancellation while output link races, failure-message redaction; demonstrate safe denial.
criteria.G13: Stable structured reason codes for enqueue/admit/defer/preempt/activate/quarantine; monotonic lifecycle transitions, tenant-filtered views, counters with explicit unknowns; operator recovery runbook and true capability surface.
criteria.G14: Predeclared matched static FIFO/single-cohort versus adaptive scheduling campaign on same executable/data/host: throughput, p50/p95 queue latency, fairness, cost/slot-ms, actual overlapping processes, peak RSS, disk, CPU where measured. Correctness guards and raw samples, no unjustified speedup claim.
criteria.G15: `cargo fmt --all -- --check`; `cargo check --workspace --all-targets --locked`; strict all-feature `clippy -D warnings`; all-feature workspace build/test with feature-matched workers; new crate no-default where applicable; `bash scripts/smoke.sh`; repository Python unittest suite; Rust 1.94 MSRV; final-SHA CI status. Do not hide service-dependent skips.
criteria.G16: Offline verifier validates source/binary/fixture/criteria/receipt integrity, independent positive and negative case counts, stage-reached witnesses, schedules and output semantics; fully rehashed tamper archives (duplicate job, swapped tenant, missing failure, forged cost/share, altered worker boot, stale SHA, relabeled support) **must be rejected**.
criteria.G17: Accepted ADR, operator guide, implementation report, support JSON, evidence manifest/archives and README/AGENTS updates; `PASS/FAIL/PARTIAL/NOT_RUN` for each gate, blockers and deferred scope; historical predecessor claims unchanged.
